title: Add “Book Now on WhatsApp” CTA linking to 9953854470

requirements.text: Add a user-facing CTA labeled “Book Now on WhatsApp” that opens a WhatsApp chat to the business number 9953854470.
acceptanceCriteria: A visible CTA labeled “Book Now on WhatsApp” is present on the website.
Clicking/tapping the CTA opens WhatsApp (or WhatsApp Web) to start a chat with number 9953854470.
On mobile devices, tapping the CTA launches WhatsApp if installed; otherwise it opens WhatsApp Web in the browser.
All user-facing text is in English.

requirements.text: Place a persistent floating WhatsApp CTA button on all sections of the single-page site so users can start a WhatsApp chat from anywhere on the page.
acceptanceCriteria: A floating WhatsApp CTA remains available while scrolling (does not block core content on mobile).
The floating CTA uses the same WhatsApp chat link as the main “Book Now on WhatsApp” CTA (number 9953854470).
The floating CTA is accessible (keyboard focusable, has an accessible name).

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose existing UI components instead).
Do not modify immutable hook files listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.frontend.immutablePaths.
Keep backend as single-actor; no backend changes are required for this WhatsApp CTA.
nonGoals: Adding any third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity is supported).
Adding real-time chat, messaging gateways, or SMS integrations.
Changing contact form backend behavior or storage.
